captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a compact MIDI keyboard controller. It features a dark grey or black plastic chassis with a 25-key piano keyboard consisting of white keys and raised black keys. The upper control panel is slightly angled and hosts a variety of interactive elements, including a small blue-tinted LCD screen, circular rotary encoder knobs, rectangular drum pads, and small function buttons. On the far left edge, there are two vertical pitch bend and modulation wheel controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact MIDI keyboard controller with a 25-key keyboard (white and black keys), an angled upper control panel, circular knobs, rectangular drum pads, an LCD screen, and pitch/mod wheels on the side, using dark grey, black, white, and blue-tinted materials.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first building the main chassis using a combination of box primitives, with one box representing the keybed base and an angled box representing the upper control panel. The 25-key keyboard is built programmatically by instantiating white keys (boxes) and black keys (smaller, raised boxes) in a repeating pattern with precise offsets. The control panel features are added by placing several cylindrical knobs, rectangular pads, a thin box for the LCD screen, and two wheel-shaped cylinders for the pitch/mod controls, all positioned using translation transforms.
